title: Released row-3213 conditional source contract

scopes.title: Partial original-coordinate identity
scopes.checked_claim: The source box has 47 original coordinates. Coordinate44 has zero center/width and no checked physical label; this diagnostic fixes it to literal0 and retains active0–43,45,46. The four failed original photometry joins remain unchanged.
scopes.unresolved: This packet does not reconstruct the FITS generator, supply event identities or resolve compact-versus-paper reductions. Separate NEXT04 consumer evidence must be explicitly accepted.

scopes.title: One withheld released observation
scopes.checked_claim: The paper compares an anchor geometric distance with a fit omitting that geometric constraint while retaining its Cepheids (§6.2 pp38,41; Table5 Fit15 p28; Figure19 p40). The separately declared diagnostic withholds only original row3213, retaining the remaining3491 released rows, full joint covariance and same normalized46-coordinate finite box. Training uses the principal covariance marginal C_TT, not a deleted precision block.
scopes.unresolved: The diagnostic retains full-fit prior, reference-modulus preprocessing, globally conditioned MW summaries and photometry/clipping. Eq2 versus displayed y/L sign, physical row/reduction joins, true refit/selection/calibration, train rank/SPD, finite-box evidence ratio budgets and native consumer acceptance remain open.

limitations: Targeted source claims and reviewer-derived formal diagnostic only: zero Luna/full-paper reads, no extraction/review stage promotion.
The finite box and released preprocessing retain full-fit/withheld information. This is conditional on those frozen products, with no independent physical heldout interpretation.
Riess v3 Eq2 and displayed y/L have an unrepaired anchor-offset sign inconsistency. No physical distance projection is accepted.
No FITS decoding, array extraction, rank/SPD calculation, table rejoin, refit, density/evidence computation or numerical qualification occurred.
No source-equivalent Fit15 reproduction, new H0 measurement or cosmological tension significance. Missing cross-covariances remain unknown.
